| infl.      | class      | meaning                                        |
| ---------- | ---------- | ---------------------------------------------- |
| ~          | *n.*       | rest, relaxation, break, downtime              |
| ~en        | *v.*       | to rest, take a break, relax, calm down, chill |
| ...thu ~en | *caus. v.* | to calm sb. down, to soothe                    |
| ~a         | *psv.*     | relaxed, soothed, chill, calm                  |
| ~an        | *adj.*     | relaxing, soothing, calming                    |
### Connotation
- sleep (rest of the body)
- stop (rest from movement/an action)
### Etymology
#### Glyph
休, a man resting on a tree & sheltered by the shade of the leaves
#### Sound
- Chinese "xiu"
- *a priori:* sh=quiet, u=protection
